value_proposition: Pakistan-first bilingual (Urdu/English) household expense tracking and financial planning cockpit. Helps families calculate monthly ration budgets, estimate progressive electricity slabs, visualize daily kharcha leaks, manage bill reminders, and survive inflation without complicated accounting spreadsheets.
target_audiences: Salaried professionals & middle-class heads of households in Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta)
Joint families pooling monthly income and managing shared groceries and utilities
University students and young singles budgeting hostel, mess, and transport expenses
Tech-savvy Pakistani home-makers and budget keepers looking for Urdu-first expense logging
Overseas Pakistanis managing household remittances sent to families in Pakistan
markets: Pakistan (Primary: Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta)
Overseas Pakistani Remitters (UAE, Saudi Arabia, UK, Canada, US)
